decision: Recover the hard-selection half of the predeclared hard-versus-random anchor-selection decision from its wave58 checkpoint without retraining. The hard cell completed two healthy epochs (state effective rank 84.82), then failed only because the shared wrapper passed an unsupported --corruption-mode argument during post-training audit. Re-run its four frozen representation audits and fixed deployment-feasible current-buffer GAR evaluation at 128 episodes, 256 candidates, and horizon 4. Do not duplicate or preempt the matched random-selection negative control, which remains active; recover it only after it becomes terminal if its checkpoint is intact. Once both controls are available, compare them against the positive-anchor seed-0 reference of 0.09139 normalized edit-distance improvement. A healthy target-free control requires finite losses, state effective rank at least 50, and token-aligned shuffled-action error ratio above 1. At least 0.08 improvement advances the better target-free recipe to seeds 1 and 2; both controls below 0.05 imply material dependence on candidate/terminal-privileged training-anchor selection; intermediate outcomes require one targeted replication. Planning candidates and scores remain target-free.

jobs.purpose: Recover frozen hard-selection representation and horizon-4 planning evidence from the completed checkpoint.
